description: This file contains Redux reducers and related functions for managing channel entities in the Mattermost web application, including handling channels, memberships, stats, roles, and related data structures.

methods.name: removeMemberFromChannels
methods.description: Removes a user from all channels in the state.

methods.name: channelListToSet
methods.description: Converts a list of channels into a set of channel IDs per team.

methods.name: removeChannelFromSet
methods.description: Removes a channel ID from a set of channels associated with a team.

methods.name: currentChannelId
methods.description: Reducer managing the currently selected channel ID.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Reducer managing the channels object, handling creation, updates, deletion, and archiving.

methods.name: toClientChannel
methods.description: Converts server channel object to client channel object, removing internal properties.

methods.name: channelsInTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing the set of channel IDs per team.

methods.name: receiveChannelMember
methods.description: Updates or adds a channel member in the state, with logic to handle last viewed and update times.

methods.name: membersInChannel
methods.description: Reducer managing channel members, handling addition, removal, and updates.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Reducer managing channel statistics such as member count and pinned posts.

methods.name: channelsMemberCount
methods.description: Reducer managing the member count per channel.

methods.name: groupsAssociatedToChannel
methods.description: Reducer managing groups associated with channels.

methods.name: updateChannelMemberSchemeRoles
methods.description: Updates scheme roles for channel members.

methods.name: manuallyUnread
methods.description: Reducer managing channels manually marked as unread.

methods.name: channelMemberCountsByGroup
methods.description: Reducer managing member counts grouped by group ID.

methods.name: roles
methods.description: Reducer managing roles assigned to channel members.

methods.name: restrictedDMs
methods.description: Reducer managing restricted direct messages per channel.
